text:
Maya H: Quick heads-up  two new hires starting Mon: Aisha (F-1 OPT, remote CA) and Diego (on an EAD card, hybrid SF). Checkr flagged work authorization docs as "vendor review". Aisha's STEM extension (I-765 receipt) is pending; Diego's EAD expiration is in 4 months.
Priya S: Thanks Maya. Two separate compliance flows: 1) For Aisha we can do I-9 now if she has an unexpired List A doc (EAD) or if she only has the I-797 receipt we need to follow USCIS guidance: candidate can present receipt notice + previous EAD if applicable; otherwise we must reverify when EAD arrives. 2) For Diego if EAD expires in <6 months we still accept it for I-9 but note reverify date on Section 3 when needed.
Lucas W: Ops/IT note: Diego wants hardware day 1 onsite. We can hold laptop for ID verification or have him bring originals. If Diego's EAD is expiring soon we should still provision temporary access but mark for reverify in 90 days.
Carmen J: Payroll/legal: for Aisha (F-1) we need to confirm tax residency status; she might be a nonresident alien for tax. Please collect completed Form 8233 or confirm treaty eligibility if relevant. Also benefits eligibility differs for F-1s — check benefits lead.
Maya H: Aisha only has the I-797 receipt (STEM filed) and a copy of her old EAD that expired last month. She is asking if we can onboard and defer final verification until new card arrives.
Priya S: Legal safe path: allow Section 1 completion and use an authorized rep for Section 2 if she can present the old EAD + I-797 receipt in person to a notary or our rep; note the pending status in GH. We'll require the new physical EAD or approval notice within 90 days to keep active access. I'll draft a special reverify note.
Lucas W: I'll do the authorized rep slot Mon 9am (I'll be onsite). If Aisha prefers not to travel, reimburse notary. IT will set laptop "Hold for reverify" tag.
Carmen J: Payroll: if she's NR for tax with treaty, payroll needs Form 8233 before first payroll to withhold correctly. If she can't provide 8233 yet, payroll warns there may be default withholding. We should nudge candidate.
Maya H: I'll DM Aisha the checklist: Section 1 link, 8233 info, and notary reimbursement form. Also asked candidate to upload I-797 + copy of expired EAD to Checkr ticket.
HR Bot: Onboarding checklist: I-9, W-4, direct deposit, visa docs, benefits eligibility. Guide: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/onboarding-visa. Auto-reminder 72h pre-start.
Priya S: For Diego: ask him to bring original EAD on Day 1. If he can't, we can accept a notary'd Section 2 or have Lucas inspect. Since EAD expires in 4 months we must set a calendar reminder to reverify before expiry. I'll add reverify flag in HRIS.
Lucas W: Adding: I'll inspect originals for both Diego and Aisha if they come to office. If not, we will accept notary but ensure the rep form includes commission/state. Do not use external recruiters as reps.
Carmen J: Also: Aisha's benefits start date may be postponed until her FTE status is confirmed. I'll coordinate with benefits lead and let Maya know.
Maya H: Update: Aisha scheduled a notary Thu 10am and will upload receipt. Diego confirmed he'll be onsite Mon at 08:30 with original EAD.
PayrollBot: Reminder: to avoid default tax withholding, collect W-4 and any treaty/8233 forms before payroll cutoff Fri EOD.
Priya S: Compliance note: when using the receipt notice (I-797) plus expired EAD we must document vendor case and reverify when new EAD arrives. Put a short note in secure HR file and Greenhouse.
Maya H: Sent quick DM to Aisha asking for 8233 status and notary confirmation. Also created Checkr ticket #CHK-9122 for both candidates.
Lucas W: I'll be at front desk Mon 8:15 to sign Section 2 if they show. Adding the "reverify" calendar reminder for Diego on the expiry date minus 14 days.
Carmen J: Benefits follow-up: I flagged Aisha as "pending benefits" and benefits lead will email next steps post-approval. Also payroll asked to confirm if Aisha will be paid as contractor or employee until STEM card arrives  I'll follow up with Maya.
Maya H: Quick update 17:20: Aisha uploaded I-797 + expired EAD, notary receipt scheduled, payroll confirmed they can process with default withholding if no 8233 but prefer to wait for 8233. Diego confirmed EAD originals and will come in.
Priya S: Final: 20:40 Checkr cleared after docs, Lucas did in-person Section 2 for Diego Mon morning and uploaded scans, Aisha completed notary and uploaded signed Section 2 + receipt, reverify flags added in HRIS, payroll processed with correct withholding after 8233 arrived. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
